ai.title: Meet Drex Max: Nace AI’s Multimodal Decision Model for Computer-Use Agents with a Score 67.59
ai.brief: Nace AI has released Drex Max , a multimodal decision model for agents that use computers and browsers. The Drex Max multimodal decision model reads text and images and returns calibrated probabilities. It writes no text. 14. For agent builders, that means one cheap, typed call per click. TL;DR Size: Parameters not disclosed. Up to 262,144 tokens per question on the API, including image tokens. Runs on: Hosted API only ( drex-max on Nace Console). No open weights or quantized builds announced. 2 (public), the top score Nace lists for any decision model. 14. 14. What is Drex Max? Drex Max is a decision model from Nace AI that answers typed questions about text and images. It is the most accurate model in the Drex family , and the only one that reads images. A decision model does not generate tokens. You send a state and named questions.
